versions.content: If more than one N-PDU is used for one N-SDU within a connection, the FrIf shall guarantee, that the N-PDUs (L-SDUs) are scheduled (sent over the bus) in the same order the FlexRay AUTOSAR Transport Layer uses them, i.e. in ascending order regarding the N-PDU IDs used in the FlexRay AUTOSAR Transport Layer. To simplify configuration, all PDUs of a pool shall be arranged such that they are always received in the same order in which they have been transmitted, independent of the current cycle in the FlexRay communication round.
